## Overview

This backward-compatible release improves PowerPoint export fidelity. CSS corner
radii are preserved on native rounded shapes and images, and box-shadow fallback
captures no longer include paint from neighboring elements.

## Compatibility and migration

This release is backward compatible. Existing Markdown decks and installations
continue to work; update only version-pinned installations to the new release.

| Area | Migration |
| --- | --- |
| Version-pinned installation | Update the pinned tag to `v4.5.1`. |
